name: Ataxx
description: Grow your colony: clone a piece to a neighbouring square or jump two squares, and every enemy piece next to where you land turns to your side.
rules: Each turn move one of your pieces to an empty square at most two squares away (counting diagonals). One square away is a clone — the original stays, so you gain a piece; two squares away is a jump — the original moves.
Every opposing piece adjacent to the square you land on is converted to your colour.
A player with no legal move passes. The game ends when the board is full or neither player can move; the player with more pieces wins.

Optional (chosen when the game is made): with the pie rule, the second player may swap sides on their first turn instead of replying; the players change seats and the opening move changes hands with them.
